scope: Current Define AlchLang, shared Lab runtime, complete current catalog, per-workspace layout, authority and downstream consumers. Runtime/admission code and live stores were not modified.

findings.title: Piped AlchLang source export exits successfully with truncated output
findings.observed: Actual sources response is 146176 bytes; the source asset is 308581 bytes; exit status is zero.
findings.contract_needed: Reuse the complete stdout/byte-preserving response contract for every exporting CLI command.
findings.next: Await stdout completion and verify exact byte/hash equality for a piped sources response. Generic transport only; no Define business rules move out of AlchLang.

findings.title: Active documentation still calls three admitted definitions unadmitted
findings.observed: The 44-entry Define design selection has three candidate-unadmitted labels whose exact bodies are admitted-current: Lab Workspace, Definition Pack and CyberAlchemy Define. All 44 selected paths still exist. The other pinned versions may validly remain historical semantic dependencies.
findings.contract_needed: Explicit historical as-of selection versus current authority lookup; no new admission decision.
findings.next: Keep original decisions and pinned meaning bytes; update live guidance/current standing resolution and annotate historical design snapshots.

findings.title: Catalog readers do not authenticate publication receipts
findings.observed: On a disposable SQLite backup, changing the latest publication receipt makes verified inspection fail publication-retained-evidence-corrupt. readPublishedCatalog still returns 377 versions and 188 current entries.
findings.contract_needed: Verified catalog observation bound to selector, authenticated publication history and exact snapshot; reported discovery remains distinct from semantic acceptance.
findings.next: Use trusted publication verification or an equivalently authenticated snapshot proof before exposing admitted standing. Keep this trust check in the Lab reader, not Define semantics.

findings.title: A new publication can opt out of workspace layout validation
findings.observed: verifyLocations accepts the actual 377-entry current registry after locations, layout and layout_protocol are omitted, performing zero location reads. The publisher has no separate trusted mandatory-layout policy.
findings.contract_needed: Trusted, nonregressing workspace layout policy for new publications, with explicit historical-read compatibility.
findings.next: Require the active layout independently of producer declarations; retain explicit historical reads for older valid snapshots.

findings.title: The four-file definition directory is not a complete bound publication unit
findings.observed: The current snapshot contains all 188 readable bodies, 183 readable Markdown paths, zero readable field-lineage paths and zero readable evidence paths. Location validation passes with lineage/evidence reads blocked. All four files do exist in every current physical directory and current Markdown renders correctly. Five existing v2 projections retain historical bindings.
findings.contract_needed: A per-version Definition directory manifest binding body, deterministic projection, full field-lineage and referenced evidence, including readable location aliases for retained originals.
findings.next: Bind and validate all required assets; preserve original body/projection evidence and require verified package/lineage facts. Existing placement retries must check evidence.json too.

findings.title: Ready status does not attest canonical filesystem mirrors
findings.observed: Operational readiness remains ready while reads of authority/definitions/current.json and every current directory Markdown/lineage/evidence file are blocked in-process. It attempts none of those reads. The real live files are currently valid; no live file was changed.
findings.contract_needed: Separate or combined view-reconciliation readiness covering canonical selection, workspace manifests and generated indexes, plus recovery after publication/view-update interruption.
findings.next: Expose filesystem/view health explicitly and reconcile public current.json/index/catalog projections against the selected signed snapshot without rewriting frozen legacy registry.json.

findings.kind: maintained workflow and evolution coverage gap
findings.title: Routine handoff-to-admission orchestration remains migration-specific
findings.observed: Generic review, construction, native apply, publication, joins and recovery exist. The successful complete driver is under the 0077 work plan, with fixed accepted target set and batch assumptions; no maintained consumer of PreparedHandoff/ReportedHandoffResponse was found. Placement unconditionally preserves current meaning/owner/name. Home assignments are pinned into the implementation closure.
findings.contract_needed: Reusable package/handoff consumption, explicit owner decisions, governed home assignment, reviewed v2 successor/meaning change and custody/name evolution, durable publication and acknowledgement correlation.
findings.next: Promote the orchestration into a maintained Lab workflow driven by actual accepted inputs/current authority. Keep representation-preserving import strict and add separate reviewed evolution routes; do not create another runtime or put construction enforcement into Define.

findings.title: Impact is complete only for a hand-selected consumer graph
findings.observed: The qualified universe has 388 subjects. Every one of its 377 Definition-version nodes has dependencies: []; the builder adds registry, two readers, runtime closure and seven workspace profiles. This is not a discovered whole-Lab dependency projection.
findings.contract_needed: Governed dependency projection and coverage receipts for definitions, carrier/schema/generator/lineage consumers, records and other actual downstream users; explicit meaning of dependency edge kinds.
findings.next: Reuse ontology relations and source bindings to build and verify the declared graph, distinguish provenance from normative dependency, and report omitted/unresolved consumers rather than assuming whole-Lab closure.

findings.owner: shared Lab and owning workspace record authorities
findings.title: Workspace metadata and generic record primitives are ahead of complete business-record operating flows
findings.observed: Define, People and Teams, and Lab Website profiles have primary_subject.ref null. The real product-only Define context resolves without a store, then refuses native-project-context-mismatch with the active native store. Generic create emits RecordOutputs to an explicit caller output; the shared published catalog is Definition-specific. The native store contains 640 artifact-instance versions and registered record/type mechanisms, largely imported or derived; the 24 new branch transactions target definitions and Registry/v2, not a new product/work record rollout.
findings.contract_needed: Bindings to existing/admitted business instances, workspace/native-host context bridge, per-kind record custody/output rules and verified product/project/work record journeys.
findings.next: Reuse already bound Craft/Ontology/other assets and admit only genuinely absent records through their owners. Support workspace-native routing or an explicit host-project bridge without inventing Projects for product-only preparation or copying runtime code.

responsibility_boundary.Define: Author, prepare, validate and report candidate meaning/packages, scoped readiness, observed handoff and reported acknowledgement.
responsibility_boundary.shared_Lab: Workspace/record context, semantic owner decisions, permission, construction chain, native admission, canonical layout/publication, trusted readers, impact/conformance and recovery.

definition_coverage: No additional missing global definition was demonstrated. The three documented unadmitted Define definitions are already admitted exact bodies. Select existing canonical meanings first; complete the specific missing contracts above through the defined chain before fixes.
